title: Check before trusting a network
summary: Training, validation and test sets have different jobs. Validation helps choose settings. The final test checks a choice that has already been made.
introduction: Training, validation and test sets have different jobs. Validation helps choose settings. The final test checks a choice that has already been made. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain check before trusting a network
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Training, validation and test sets have different jobs. Validation helps choose settings. The final test checks a choice that has already been made.

blocks.code:
Training: adjust weights
Validation: choose settings and when to stop
Test: report the final check
Report: describe errors and data limits
blocks.title: Check before trusting a network

blocks.text: Keeping these jobs separate reduces the chance of tuning the model to the answers used for the final report.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why repeatedly picking settings from final test scores is a problem.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A large network can learn unfair or misleading patterns from its data. Check important groups and failure cases.
For more detail later, use this [Deep Learning further reading](https://d2l.ai/chapter_introduction/index.html).
